name: Enomoto Mikaru
source:
The protagonist's cousin.
She is a first-year university student, from which the protagonist graduated. Since it is close to where he lives, she moved in with him.
Despite her blond hair, she is actually not a tsundere. She is a lively type of girl, with a clumsy side at times.
Her special talent is immunity to the foul-mouthed Michiru.
